title: match / search / fullmatch 的起点与终点差异（含 IPv4 校验）
expected_output:
=== match / search / fullmatch 的起点与终点 ===
match    : None
search   : 123
fullmatch: None
search+锚: abc123xyz

=== IPv4 校验：三种写法的差异 ===
输入               search     fullmatch 
'192.168.1.1'    True       True      
'192.168.1.1 '   True       False     
' 192.168.1.1'   True       False     
'1.2.3'          False      False     
'1.2.3.4.5'      True       False     

结论：search 放过了带空格与多余段的串；校验格式必须用 fullmatch。
code:
import re

print("=== match / search / fullmatch 的起点与终点 ===")
s = "abc123xyz"
print("match    :", re.match(r"\d+", s))        # 只从开头试 -> None
print("search   :", re.search(r"\d+", s).group())
print("fullmatch:", re.fullmatch(r"\d+", s))     # 要求整串 -> None
print("search+锚:", re.fullmatch(r"abc\d+xyz", s).group())

print()
print("=== IPv4 校验：三种写法的差异 ===")
def by_search(text):
    return re.search(r"(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}", text) is not None
def by_fullmatch(text):
    return re.fullmatch(r"(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}", text) is not None

cases = ["192.168.1.1", "192.168.1.1 ", " 192.168.1.1", "1.2.3", "1.2.3.4.5"]
print("%-16s %-10s %-10s" % ("输入", "search", "fullmatch"))
for c in cases:
    print("%-16r %-10s %-10s" % (c, by_search(c), by_fullmatch(c)))
print()
print("结论：search 放过了带空格与多余段的串；校验格式必须用 fullmatch。")
